title: Classical Energies Learn to Reason 1,000x Faster than Looped Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.17309v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped models have emerged as a prominent paradigm for reasoning, with successes on simple reasoning puzzles such as Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Unique. However, these models can be unstable, slow to train, and use many parameters and FLOPs to solve simple puzzles. Descent on an energy not only mitigates these issues but also offers advantages: built-in early stopping, compute that adapts to problem difficulty, fast training without differentiating through a solver, and interpretable weights that learn the constraints of the puzzle. Here we demonstrate this with a learned version of Hopfield & Tank's energy from the 80s, which we term CRAM, solves 99.996% of Sudoku-Extreme and 100% of Maze-Unique test puzzles after 42 ms and 132 ms of training on one GPU, at least 1,000x faster than looped models on these tasks. CRAM also matches baseline looped models at their highest accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme using at least 282x fewer inference FLOPs. Our

translated_title: 经典能量函数学会推理：比循环模型快1000倍
translated_abstract: 循环模型已成为推理任务的重要范式，在数独极限（Sudoku-Extreme）和迷宫唯一（Maze-Unique）等简单推理谜题上取得了成功。然而，这些模型可能不稳定、训练缓慢，并且需要大量参数和浮点运算（FLOPs）来解决简单谜题。基于能量下降的方法不仅能缓解这些问题，还带来了诸多优势：内置早停机制、计算量能自适应问题难度、无需对求解器进行求导的快速训练，以及能学习谜题约束的可解释权重。在此，我们通过 Hopfield & Tank 在上世纪80年代提出的能量函数的学习版本证明了这一点，我们将其命名为 CRAM。该方法在单个 GPU 上分别仅需 42 毫秒和 132 毫秒的训练，即可在数独极限测试集上达到 99.996% 的解题率，在迷宫唯一测试集上达到 100% 的解题率，比循环模型在这些任务上至少快 1000 倍。此外，CRAM 在数独极限任务上以至少少 282 倍的推理浮点运算量，达到了与基线循环模型最高准确率相当的水平。
tldr: 提出基于 Hopfield & Tank 经典能量函数的学习版本 CRAM，通过能量下降实现推理，在数独和迷宫谜题上仅需毫秒级训练即可达到近乎完美的准确率，速度比循环模型快至少1000倍，推理计算量减少至少282倍。
en_tdlr: CRAM, a learned version of Hopfield & Tank's 1980s classical energy function, solves reasoning puzzles like Sudoku-Extreme and Maze-Unique with 1,000x faster training than looped models while achieving higher accuracy with at least 282x fewer inference FLOPs.
